Special Trains Announced for Jagannath Rath Yatra

Indian Railways has announced the operation of five special trains on the Bokaro-Bhubaneswar route to facilitate devotees traveling for the Jagannath Rath Yatra. This initiative aims to provide convenient travel options for pilgrims attending the significant religious event.
